answer: Admission by capped lottery: each epoch only 200 seats open, and a ticket costs 25 POA locked for 20 epochs. One funder may hold at most 4 tickets, and each ticket beyond the first needs a bridge deposit twice the previous one, so the fifth fake costs 400. Rewards are a nectar paid slowly, and a pearl of evidence, such as a shared funding path, lets any auditor claim half the forfeited stake after a 2-of-3 panel check.
